visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A female staff member wearing a white protective mask and black gloves pulls a large metal tray full of orange-brown bread rolls from an industrial cooling rack. The background shows a storefront with blurred street elements and a sign. (2) A street-level view captures a small group of people standing in a queue outside a retail storefront with a red and white sign. A person in a gray shirt and black skirt stands in the foreground, facing the shop entrance. (3) Multiple close-up shots showcase trays of golden-brown twisted donuts, also known as braid donuts, which are heavily coated in white granulated sugar. The lighting is bright and studio-like, highlighting the textured crystalline surface of the sugar crystals. (4) Two hands pull a sugar-coated twisted donut apart from the center. The camera captures the internal white dough stretching, revealing a soft, stringy, and airy texture. The movement is slow and deliberate to emphasize the bread's flexibility. (5) A staff member hands a plastic bag containing white paper-wrapped donuts to a customer. The transaction takes place at a counter with various promotional posters and a wooden wall in the background. (6) Several dark chocolate-colored donuts are displayed in paper bags on a metal shelf. One is broken open by hands to show a white cream cheese filling inside the dark, dense dough structure. (7) A golden-brown, croissant-shaped pastry with a glossy surface and visible salt crystals is held up. The background is the interior of the bakery with menu boards and kitchen equipment visible in soft focus. (8) The camera focuses on a printed menu board displaying various donut flavors, including cinnamon, citrus chocolate, and cheese, along with their respective prices in a clean, graphic layout. (9) The final shot shows the storefront from across the street. The building has a large vertical sign for 'Lao Jiang' and is located on a street corner with power lines and other urban buildings.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A male narrator begins with a fast-paced and enthusiastic delivery. The background music is an upbeat acoustic folk-pop track featuring a bright acoustic guitar rhythm and a steady, driving percussive beat. A metallic sliding sound is clearly heard as a heavy tray is adjusted on a cooling rack. (2) The narrator's voice maintains a friendly, high-energy narrative tone while describing the texture of the donuts. The background music continues at a consistent tempo. Subtle foley-like sounds of paper bags rustling and soft plastic crinkling occur as items are handled and packaged for customers. (3) The vocal delivery concludes with a professional summary of the shop's location and brand name. The background music intensity remains stable until the very end, where it swells slightly before a hard cut to silence as the video finishes.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to promote the newly introduced donut and pastry products at the famous 'Lao Jiang' shop in Kaohsiung. It uses high-energy narration and close-up 'food porn' visuals to emphasize texture and freshness, targeting local food enthusiasts.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Detailed product showcase, mention of specific store location, and high production value focused on a single brand.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video effectively combines traditional food vlogging styles with fast-paced social media editing to highlight a heritage brand's new modern offerings.
